name: siffran
description: Dmitry's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace — methodology-driven tools for rigorous engineering.

plugins.name: methodologist
plugins.description: Methodology router — selects and executes formal reasoning methodologies (axioms/proofs, decomposition, invariant analysis, contradiction, abstraction refinement, empirical falsification) based on task context.

plugins.name: empirica
plugins.description: Host-neutral empirical-convergence workflow — routes uncertainty into a claim graph, requires cited research before deterministic spikes, derives claim state, and binds convergence to a current independent audit. Full execution is hook-enforced only on profiles with author-action and bound-audit capabilities; unsupported profiles fail explicitly before starting.
